title: docs(theme): document fontFamily customization in themeVariables
body:
📑 Summary
Clarified that fontFamily can be customized via themeVariables in the Theming documentation
Resolves #6542

📏 Design Decisions
Since the documentation already listed fontFamily as a default value, I kept the existing table entry and expanded the description to mention it can be customized.

### :clipboard: Tasks

- [ ] :butterfly: If your PR makes a change that should be noted in one or more packages' changelogs, generate a changeset by running `pnpm changeset` and following the prompts. Changesets that add features should be `minor` and those that fix bugs should be `patch`. Please prefix changeset messages with `feat:`, `fix:`, or `chore:`.

This extra space is breaking formatting. 

```suggestion
| fontFamily | trebuchet ms, verdana, arial | Font family for diagram text; can be customized via `themeVariables`.                                       |
| fontSize | 16px | Font size in pixels |
```

comments.author: nourhenta
comments.body: Thank you for catching that! You’re absolutely right — the extra space was breaking the table formatting. I’ve corrected it now.
